title: 8-Speed Transmission Shudder/Harsh Shifts
caption:
Attention Chevrolet Colorado owners: if you have a 2015–2023 Colorado with the 8-speed automatic, watch for transmission shudder or harsh shifts. Affected trucks may develop a vibration during light acceleration, usually around 25–50 mph, along with jerky shifts, hesitation, or a clunk at low speeds.

This issue is commonly linked to the 8L45 transmission’s torque converter clutch. The first step is usually a transmission fluid flush with GM-approved fluid and friction modifier. Some trucks improve after multiple fluid changes, and GM has extended warranty coverage for certain vehicles. In more severe cases, torque converter replacement may be needed.

Typical repair cost: $200–$3000.

If you’re noticing these symptoms, it’s worth getting it checked before drivability gets worse. See the full repair guide at au7o.io (link in bio)
